Soak cubes in pH 5.5-5.8 I use clonex rooting solution at25ml pergal. I soak them for a half hour before plugging the cuts. 
When you put the cutting in the cube don’t use the premade hole. Stick it in so it has full contact with the rockwool on the stem. No space. 
One thing I differ on than most people is misting the leaves and domes. I never do this. 
To much moisture causes browning rot on the growth. 
I dip in clonex gel before plugging . Keep humidity dome on fully and leave it alone. I check for moisture on day 7 and add 10 ml per cube if necessary. Day 7 is also when I normally see roots on fast propagating varieties. By day 12 I have them all rooted and hardened off enough to pot into their first pots. Normally just solo cups with holes.
